text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release v3.5.2 -> prod/us-west at 2026-03-21T14:05Z. Canary completed (10% -> 100%). Starting postdeploy smoke suite: short-prompt-synth, kv-warmup, embed-route-quickcheck. Logs: /deploy/1795054321/status

annie: saw synth-run kick off, running short-prompt-synth now. will report p95 and error counts in a minute.

ken: thx. I'll watch telemetry (p95 / errors / 5xx) on the dashboard.

annie: short-prompt-synth results: p50 48ms p95 245ms p99 520ms. baseline p95 was ~190ms pre-deploy. errors 0.6% (baseline 0.2%). kv-warmup looks fine. embed-route quickcheck passes.

shreya: interesting — p95 spike only on /generate-route (large-context prompts). other endpoints stable. Any correlation with quant profile?

liam: checking rollout config: we switched to quant2-8bit on this variant (v3.5.2-quant2). Could be kernel warmstart behavior for longer sequences.

annie: I can re-run synth with longer tails to confirm. Re-run command: `./scripts/run_synth --probe short-prompt-synth --tail 512 --samples 200`

oncall-bot: Alert: synth p95 > threshold (200ms) for /generate-route in prod/us-west at 2026-03-21T14:07Z :warning:

ken: ops question — do we want to hold rollout or pin back to v3.5.1 for /generate-route only? We can route 20% of traffic back to stable variant.

shreya: prefer not to full rollback yet. Let's do a targeted pin for the embed route or set routing policy -> stable for large-context. Add a temporary route rule: if prompt_tokens > 256 -> route to v3.5.1.

liam: I can push that routing rule. Patching Routenet policy now: `routenet update --if "prompt_tokens>256" --to v3.5.1 --weight 100 --env prod/us-west`

annie: re-run synth (tail512) after rule applied.

deploy-bot: Routing rule applied by liam at 2026-03-21T14:09Z. Canary traffic adjusted.

annie: re-run results after rule: p95 for /generate-route now 198ms, errors 0.25%. That brings it within threshold. Full synth tails show reduced memory churn.

ken: nice. Can we mark this as a 'soft pin' in the release notes and add a follow-up ticket to investigate quant2 kernel path for long sequences?

shreya: yes — I'll open a Jira: INF-7642 "quant2-8bit p95 regression on long-context generate-route" with repro steps and synth configs. assign to runtime-team.

liam: also schedule a canary with longer tails overnight (apac windows) to validate kernel warmup under different hardware.

annie: +1. I'll add extended-synth job to nightly pipeline.

oncall-bot: Note recorded: postdeploy soft-pin applied (route rule) and synth threshold breach resolved.

ken: OK to proceed with normal monitoring and close this thread unless we see reappearance. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

annie: adding small note to changelog: "v3.5.2: applied temporary routing rule for long-context /generate-route due to p95 increase; investigating quant2 kernel warmstart."

shreya: moving to follow-up. I'll track INF-7642, assign next steps.

liam: leaving the routing rule in place for 24h then re-evaluate.

ken: last check — will we need a rollback if it regresses elsewhere? add fallback plan: immediate route rollback to stable + rollback flag in deploybot.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. rollback plan available: `deploy rollback --to v3.5.1 --scope prod/us-west` (requires 2 approvals).

annie: thanks — monitoring continues.

ken: closing thread in 1 hour if green.

(attachments: synth output snippet, short grep of logs: `2026-03-21T14:06:12 synth short-prompt p95=245ms`, `2026-03-21T14:09:02 routing rule applied by liam`)
